problem.observedSourceGap: The 54 m x 36 m GrassField already had metre-scaled two-frequency PBR, but its broad lawn silhouette remained a perfectly flat primitive surface outside localized tree understory. This can limit vegetation natural complexity and expose a texture-only lawn tell in oblique/grazing 4K views.
problem.nonDuplicationDecision: Do not add another tree/crown/understory system. Add only a broad-lawn blade silhouette layer over the existing GrassField material substrate.
